contexts.goal: Comprehensive Troubleshooting & Resolution for: Screen flickers and battery dies fast
contexts.title: Smart Diagnostics: Screen flickers and battery dies fast
contexts.summary: Generated a detailed multi-step resolution plan covering automated settings, manual verification steps, and hardware checks.

actions.description: Inspect background app battery consumption and clear battery cache to stop drain.

steps: Open Device Settings > Battery and Device Care.
Enable 'Put unused apps to sleep' and restrict high drain background applications.

actions.description: Adjust motion smoothness and disable adaptive brightness flicker triggers.
prerequisites: Ensure screen protective film is intact

steps: Go to Settings > Display > Motion Smoothness.
Switch from 'Adaptive' (120Hz) to 'Standard' (60Hz) to isolate hardware frequency issue.
Toggle off 'Adaptive Brightness' and test screen flicker response.
